scoring_justification: Full DFT recomputation is infeasible in the verifier; the checker compares self-reported aggregate numbers against paper gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference adsorption energies, diffusion barriers, and specific capacities from the source paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys., 2020, DOI: 10.1039/D0CP01133A): text and values for adsorption energy, diffusion barriers (e.g., 0.18/0.47/0.44 eV), and specific capacities (1251.7 and 1235.9 mAh/g).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's main text and tables; PC2 adsorption energy -0.94, PC5 -0.84, PC6 -0.83 from Fig. S5 text; barriers from Fig. 5/Fig. S6 text; capacities from Fig. 6 text and equation (5). PC2 capacity computed from max loading (2 Li per 2×2 supercell = 0.25 per f.u., formula weight 43.0 g/mol) → 121.8 mAh/g, consistent with paper mention that PC2 cannot hold high capacity.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All numbers are direct transcriptions of the paper's reported results for the same quantities; the oracle solve.sh writes identical values, ensuring correctness.

schema.description: ZIP archive containing three CIF/POSCAR files. Checker verifies existence of required files and basic structure (low weight).

outputs.description: Geometry-optimized structures of PC2, PC5, and PC6 monolayers.
Li adsorption energy at the most stable site for each monolayer.
Li diffusion energy barrier (minimum energy path) for each monolayer.
Maximum Li atom content per formula unit and corresponding theoretical specific capacity.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares diffusion barriers and specific capacities to hidden paper reference values using tolerance of ±0.05 eV and 5% relative, respectively; meeting or exceeding (lower barrier, higher capacity) earns full credit. Adsorption energies are checked for consistency with hidden paper values. Structure files are audited for existence and minimal content.

steps.description: Check that the ZIP contains PC2.cif, PC5.cif, PC6.cif and each is non-trivial.
